full_judgment: 10. The appellant instituted Miscellaneous Case No. 251 of 1987 under Section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 for pre-empting a share of the holding described in the application stating that she was a co-sharer of the holding in question by purchase 1½ decimals of land by registered kabalas dated 10.8.79 and 6.11.79 from the original owner, Md. Idris Ali and that on the death of Idris Ali his son Md. Zamir Ali, predecessor-in-interest of respondent Nos. 2-4, transferred the land under pre-emption by a registered kabala dated 18.11.1982 to the pre-emptee respondent No. 1. Md. Abu Zaher, a stranger to the holding without serving statutory notice under Section 89 of the Act upon her.
